_: The ground's look (land3d.gd, terrain.gd read it through data.gd; docs/TUNING.md). The painted look (art-direction/concept-town-repaint.png; Foundation and Tiny Glade's soft painted ground): layers: Terrain3D's ground layers, each a painting of the look audit's painted ground (assets/ground/painted_v2, docs/art/ground/sheet.jpg; packed by tools/pack_painted_ground.gd into assets/ground/terrain3d), its scale (texture repeats per game unit: the paintings are about 4 m a tile, 2 a unit) and, if ever needed, a tint (multiplies it; the paint is final, none now); a wider beach, no surf at the shore. beach.top: how far above the waterline the sand runs (game units; today 0.02). beach.snow: [below, from] heights (game units) between which winter's snow comes in over the shore: none on the tide-washed beach below the first, whole from the second (g10 crossing: the beach white as snow). roads: a grass verge either side of each track (verge: its width as a share of the road's; vergeTint: its colour and strength, near the grass's own so it blends, not a yellow band); tint: every road's, street's and track's earth, a multiply on the painted road (assets/ground/painted_v2/dirt_road.png; 1: as painted); kingsShade: the King's road that much darker; edge: how a track frays into the grass (feather: the soft edge's width as a share of the road's; wander: how far its verges wander in and out; crown: how solid the grassy strip down the middle stays, 1 none; ruts: how dark the two wheel ruts; ends: how far each stretch's ends fray out, as a share of a tile, so the stretches of a street overlap softly instead of ending square, batch 6 (c)). wear (wear.gd): paths worn where people walk (only where they moved at least walkMin units since the last stamp: standing people wear no pads); on, how much a step wears (0..1), how much grows back each upload, how often people are stamped and the wear uploaded (seconds), the bare earth's colour. macro: Terrain3D's broad colour patches over every layer (research #3, the big low-frequency hue tint): two colours (a lush green, a sun-dried yellow), scale the patches' noise (lower is broader; Terrain3D noise1_scale), slope how much slopes take it; set whether the ground is painted or not. painting: which of the painted set's textures the layer draws (the look audit's painted ground, assets/ground/painted_v2; packed by tools/pack_painted_ground.gd into assets/ground/terrain3d); every layer takes one (tools/ground_check.gd fails a layer that doesn't); lift: how far the painting is washed toward white (the pack has no snow: the snow is its palest stone, lifted). winter.snow: the colour winter's snow lies over the land in (land3d.gd snow_col; was 0.84, 0.86, 0.91: the light pass found the square's blown whites were mostly snow, so about 0.88 of it, its blue cast kept). mesh: Terrain3D's rings of land round the lens (size: vertices across the finest ring, each further ring twice as coarse; lods: how many rings). Its default 48 drew the mid zoom's ground from points 2 units apart, sinking a lake's low shore under the water's surface (the grey smear, fields seen lying on the lake); 128 keeps half-unit detail out to about 30 units. rivers (rivers.gd): never a square end. mouthUnder: how far under the sea's or a lake's surface a river's mouth sinks (game units); mouthEase: over how many of its last points (half a unit apart) it eases down; taper: over how many points a spring's head or a river running into another narrows; thin: how narrow, as a share of its width; shallow, deep: the water's colour (the old peaty 0.2/0.26/0.2 read near black from the mid zoom).

terrain._: The ground by Freeciv's terrain (terrain.gd tile_mix; land3d.gd lays the strongest layer over the grass, blended across tile edges): each terrain's weights of the ground layers in land3d.gd's order: grass, dirt (the painted earth), sand, snow, rock, forest, mud, field, dry grass, stony. A river tile (Grassland|river) takes its terrain's. Water tiles are grass here: the beach and the sea floor come from the land's height. patches: worn earth through the grass (Mac, pass 2159: one flat lawn outside the towns; 01-town and 03-army show bare earth and varied ground): layer (its index), most (its weight at a patch's heart, times the tile's grass), from (the noise level where a patch starts: higher, fewer), soft (how far it frays), scale (noise per game unit: higher, smaller patches).

auto._: land3d.gd _control_from_land: the auto shader (rock on cliffs, by slope) only where the ground is this steep or bare grass; cliff, the normal's height under which it is a cliff (lower, fewer cliffs).

hosts._: wear.gd _facts: a host in the field wears a camp where it stands (radius camp + camp_per_men x sqrt(men), at most camp_max, game units; step a reading) and a track along the land route it moved by (track: its half-width as a share of the camp's; only moves under track_most units).

roads._: wear.gd _facts: Freeciv's roads wear their verges (width: half-width, game units; worn: how much; floor: the share of it that never grows back; per_reading: links laid each reading).

dual._: land3d.gd: the grass's second, larger scale blended in between near and far (game units from the lens), reduction its size against the first.
